value: Cryptol is a mathematically-focused programming language designed for creating, analyzing, and formally verifying complex cryptographic algorithms. It bridges the critical gap between non-executable mathematical specifications and practical implementations by allowing users to define cryptographic algorithms as executable, testable, and verifiable specifications. Paired with the Software Analysis Workbench (SAW), Cryptol facilitates high-assurance formal verification, enabling users to prove the equivalence of performant, manually-written implementations (e.g., in C or Java) against these rigorous specifications. This open-source tool, which includes a library of traditional and post-quantum algorithm specifications, ensures the correctness, security, and scalability of cryptographic systems in critical applications across national security, fintech, and cloud computing.
